name: Silent Moon
source:
Rock band "Black Teresa" loses vocalist just before its debut. There is a talented vocalist around who refuses to cooperate, but time and effort can help to change his attitude.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
摇滚乐队“Black Teresa”在出道前夕失去了主唱。附近有一名才华出众的歌手，却拒绝与他们合作，不过投入时间和努力或许能够改变他的态度。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-july-2002-viper-rsr.html]vndbreview[/url]]
